critical_premises: The quantitative demicontinuity and Lorentz-completion definitions are those in arXiv:2609.03070v1.
The order dual of c decomposes as an ell-one coordinate functional plus a scalar multiple of the ordinary limit.
The universal completion of c is the coordinate lattice of all real sequences.
unproved_limits: No universal optimal constant is claimed for arbitrary r-demicontinuous lattices.
No uniqueness or classification of the Hahn--Banach extension norm is claimed.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the canonical convergent-sequence renorming family and does not prove a universal linear improvement of the general quadratic bounds.
The extension construction exhibits sharp lattice norms on ell-infinity but does not classify all possible extensions.
An older equivalent calculation under weak-Fatou terminology remains a residual originality risk.
title: Sharp linear demicontinuity constants for the canonical renormings of \(c\)
